Frequently Asked Questions About Residential Junk Removal in Whitby, ON

items.q: Q: What does junk removal cost in Whitby?
a: A: Truck space is the whole formula — small loads from $125, single items at the low end, larger clears scaling flat with volume. The free at-the-door quote already includes stairs, dismantling and careful handling, and it can’t change after approval.

items.q: Q: Is it cheaper to save everything up and book one big pickup?
a: A: Noticeably — combined loads are volume pricing at its best. The mattress, the washer and the sectional riding together always beats three separate trips, and the quote covers whatever else joins the list once we’re there.

items.q: Q: The new appliance arrives Saturday morning — can the old one be gone first?
a: A: That’s a standard Whitby booking. Give us the delivery window and we’ll clear the outgoing unit ahead of it — 6AM starts and evening slots run seven days a week, no premium attached.

items.q: Q: Will you take things from upstairs and the basement, or curb only?
a: A: From exactly where they served. Bedrooms, basements, garages and decks are all included — floors runnered, corners padded, and nothing dragged to the curb by anyone who lives there.

items.q: Q: Do decent pieces get donated?
a: A: First, always. Furniture and appliances with life left go to donation partners before recycling or disposal enters the picture — and the well-kept pieces Whitby homes retire tend to be placed fast.
